1.consolidated_definition: Horario alterno. Sistema en el que se acomodan dos grupos en una misma ubicación, alternando el horario. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. La solución temporera del Departamento de Educación será reubicar a los estudiantes en interlocking en las escuelas Juan Corretjer y Francisco Coira a partir del lunes 27 (El Nuevo Día, 19-03-99)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Alternate schedule. A system in which two groups are accommodated in the same location, alternating their schedules. Angloism, often used. The temporary solution of the Department of Education will be to reassign students to interlocking classrooms at Juan Corretjer and Francisco Coira schools starting from Monday 27 (The New Day, 19-03-99)
